OIL.measurement_caveat: Real multi-day, multi-session measurement is still required before this cost model should be trusted for any go-live decision. Commit 33b90c31 (2026-07-08) had overwritten these real, traceable numbers with different fabricated spread/RT values (same 'USOIL' mt5_symbol, same fabricated 3-day window); this entry restores the real measured spread/RT numbers. UNRESOLVED DISCREPANCY (flagged, not changed): the raw MT5 tick log (data/spread_log.jsonl) recorded this measurement under symbol 'SpotCrude' (display_name 'OIL'), not 'USOIL'. mt5_symbol is kept as 'USOIL' here only because scripts/tsm_paper_trade.py hardcodes MT5_SYMBOL_MAP['OIL']='USOIL' and indexes its cost lookup by that literal key (COST_MAP.get(mt5_sym, 10.0)) — changing this field to 'SpotCrude' would silently break that lookup and fall back to the 10bps default, discarding this real measurement. Someone with broker access must verify whether 'USOIL' and 'SpotCrude' are the same tradeable MT5 symbol at this broker before live order routing.
